question: Resolve U1 (0x11 + DXGI = luma 27.39, content visible) vs V1 (0x11 + DXGI marker 0, hidden).
method: Same run/window: unique rgb(1,254,1) marker painted over the overlay client area + DXGI ddagrab luma diff vs hidden baseline (external SW_HIDE, same desktop state). State assertions (visible, affinity 0x11, topmost) before/after every visible capture. Sweep GPU compositing variable, N=5 per config.

step1_same_run_agreement.note: All 8 disagreements are marker=HIDDEN with luma judged VISIBLE from unrelated desktop changes; luma means in those runs were 3.97-6.17, not U1's 27.39.

gpu_status_note: Every config, including default, reports gpu_compositing=disabled_software (2d_canvas/rasterization/video also disabled_software; vulkan/opengl/webgl disabled). This host has no hardware GPU compositing available to Electron, so the 'GPU compositing ON vs OFF' variable could not actually be toggled ON: default and all flags are software-composited. U1's luma result therefore cannot be attributed to GPU compositing.
foreground_note: Every run in the inspected set had foreground=true and topmost=true immediately before capture (external focus + SetWindowPos). No backgrounded-at-capture split exists in this sweep; a true backgrounded comparison remains UNTESTED.
conclusion: DXGI under WDA_EXCLUDEFROMCAPTURE 0x11 is deterministically HIDDEN by content-specific marker detection: 20/20 valid runs, 0 marker pixels, across default, --disable-gpu-compositing, --disable-gpu and app.disableHardwareAcceleration(). The U1 luma 27.39 'content visible' is not reproduced (max luma mean 6.17) and the luma-only baseline method disagrees with the marker in 8/20 runs because it reacts to unrelated desktop content. Resolve the contradiction as detector/contamination: no evidence that DXGI honours the overlay under 0x11; the V1 hidden result is the correct, repeatable measurement. No fix is warranted.
u1_claim: Withdrawn/reclassified: U1 0x11+DXGI luma 27.39 should not be used as evidence that DXGI shows protected overlay content.
untested: c) backgrounded-at-capture: all runs were foreground/topmost; no backgrounded split measured.
d) native DXGI Desktop Duplication probe (C++/g++): not built; ffmpeg ddagrab only.
e) just-recreated vs long-lived window: not run in X1.
f) elevated capture process: not attempted; host runs Medium integrity.
